findings.name: Queue pool settings accept a negative maximum number of workers (-1) and report "Settings Updated"

findings.actual: The page shows the green message 'Settings Updated', the queue table shows 'Max Number of Workers' = -1 and the input placeholder now reads 'Currently -1'. findings.name: Statistics page reports Release 1 but the only repository has 0 releases
findings.summary: The Summary table on Statistics reports Release = 1, while the only repository (eval/harbor-handbook) shows '0 Releases' on its Releases tab, its releases RSS feed has no items, and its tag v1.0.0 offers 'New Release' (no release attached). The admin page therefore reports a release that no view of the instance shows. Every other counter I cross-checked agrees with reality (Repo 1, User 3, Org 0, Branches 2, Issue 4 = IssueOpen 3 + IssueClosed 1, Label 2, Milestone 1, Tags 1, Watch 1, Star 0, PublicKey 0 with no SSH keys). (on /-/admin/monitor/stats)
findings.expected: The Release counter should match the releases that exist on the instance. There is exactly one repository (Repo 1) and it has no releases, so Release should read 0 and agree with what the repository's Releases tab, its RSS feed and its Tags page show.
findings.actual: The Summary table on Statistics reports Release = 1, while the only repository (eval/harbor-handbook) shows '0 Releases' on its Releases tab, its releases RSS feed has no items, and its tag v1.0.0 offers 'New Release' (no release attached). The admin page therefore reports a release that no view of the instance shows. Every other counter I cross-checked agrees with reality (Repo 1, User 3, Org 0, Branches 2, Issue 4 = IssueOpen 3 + IssueClosed 1, Label 2, Milestone 1, Tags 1, Watch 1, Star 0, PublicKey 0 with no SSH keys).
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1.
Open /-/admin/monitor/stats and scroll down the Summary table: the row 'Release' shows 1 (row 'Tags' also shows 1, 'Repo' 1).
Open /eval/harbor-handbook/releases: the tab reads '0 Releases | 1 Tag' and the release list is empty.
Open /eval/harbor-handbook/releases.rss: the feed has no release item.
Open /eval/harbor-handbook/tags: the only tag v1.0.0 offers a 'New Release' action, i.e. no release is attached to it.
Reload /-/admin/monitor/stats: 'Release' still shows 1.

findings.name: User Accounts search treats % and _ as wildcards: searching "%" lists every user
findings.summary: Both searches return the whole inventory: the header stays \"User Account Management (Total: 3)\" and all three rows (alex, eval, maya) are listed, none of which contains % or _. The term is passed into the SQL LIKE pattern unescaped, so a user searching for these characters sees every account as if it matched. (on /-/admin/users)
findings.expected: No username or email contains a literal % or _, so the search should return no matching user and say so (the empty-result state), as it does for any other term that matches nothing.
findings.actual: Both searches return the whole inventory: the header stays \"User Account Management (Total: 3)\" and all three rows (alex, eval, maya) are listed, none of which contains % or _. The term is passed into the SQL LIKE pattern unescaped, so a user searching for these characters sees every account as if it matched.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open /-/admin/users (Site Administration → Identity & Access → User Accounts). The header reads "User Account Management (Total: 3)" with rows alex, eval, maya.
Type % into the "Search users..." box and press Enter.
Observe the header total and the rows.
Repeat with _ in the same box and press Enter.

findings.name: Malformed value in the \"Open with\" editors setting is silently discarded on Save, wiping the stored editors
findings.summary: Nothing is saved and nothing is said: no error or confirmation message appears anywhere, and after the save the textarea is empty again (while a value in the documented "Name = url" format does persist, so the field itself works). Saving the malformed value also wipes whatever was stored before it without a word: while testing, the custom entry "Agent5Editor = agent5edit://open?url={url}" that was saved and shown in the Clone menu was silently removed by the next save of "vscode" (the Clone menu went back to the default VS Code / VSCodium / IntelliJ IDEA entries). Reproduced twice; the setting has been restored to its original empty/default state and the Clone menu shows the defaults again. (on /-/admin/config/settings)
findings.expected: Either the malformed entry is refused with a message next to the field (and the stored editors stay as they were), or the save is confirmed with feedback; the person must never be left believing a value was stored when it was dropped, and must not lose the previously stored value without warning.
findings.actual: Nothing is saved and nothing is said: no error or confirmation message appears anywhere, and after the save the textarea is empty again (while a value in the documented "Name = url" format does persist, so the field itself works). Saving the malformed value also wipes whatever was stored before it without a word: while testing, the custom entry "Agent5Editor = agent5edit://open?url={url}" that was saved and shown in the Clone menu was silently removed by the next save of "vscode" (the Clone menu went back to the default VS Code / VSCodium / IntelliJ IDEA entries). Reproduced twice; the setting has been restored to its original empty/default state and the Clone menu shows the defaults again.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-i4ts0quf2p9cd8sm9ts9s.e2b.app/-/admin/config/settings

In the Repository section, click the expander "The "Open with" editors for the clone menu..." to see the default example entries (VS Code / VSCodium / IntelliJ IDEA in "Name = url" form); the textarea is empty
Type "vscode" (a value without the "Name = url" form) into the textarea
Press the Save button once
Look at the page: no message of any kind appears and the textarea is empty again
Contrast: type "Agent5Editor = agent5edit://open?url={url}" and press Save - that value is kept and the repo Clone menu shows "Open with Agent5Editor"
Type "vscode" over that saved value and press Save again: it disappears from the field and the stored editor is wiped (Clone menu back to the three defaults)

findings.expected: Pressing Enter submits the form exactly like clicking 'Create Organization': the validation message 'Organization Name can only contain alphanumeric chars…' appears above the form, the value is kept and no browser 'Leave site?' prompt interrupts the person.
findings.actual: Pressing Enter submits the form and the browser then shows a native 'Leave site?' / beforeunload prompt. Dismissing it leaves the person on the New Organization form with their text still in the field and no message at all — the server's answer is never displayed, so it looks as if nothing happened. Clicking the 'Create Organization' button with the same value shows the error normally and no prompt appears.

Type 'my org3' into 'Organization Name *' (a space makes the name invalid, so no organization can be created)
